# `rnd` (research) publish lane — DESIGN / REVIEW

**Status:** proposal for DevOps review. Mirrors the existing `dev` lane so
`gtc-research install` can binstall the `-rnd` toolchain binaries, the same way
`gtc-dev install` installs the `-dev` ones.

## Why

The multi-provider Agentic Worker + per-tool `input_schema` work ships on the
`research` branches. Its runtime (`greentic-aw-runtime`) is `publish = false`, so
a usable binary can only be built from git deps — it exists today as the
`greentic-start v1.2.0-research.1` release + `greentic-start-distroless:research`
image, but **not** as a `*-rnd` crate/binary the `gtc-research` toolchain
installs. The `rnd` lane closes that gap.

## The three reusable workflows (mirror of `dev-*`)

| dev lane | rnd lane | difference |
|----------|----------|------------|
| `dev-prepare.yml` | `rnd-prepare.yml` | version comes **verbatim from Cargo.toml `X.Y.Z-research`** (no `RUN_ID` stamping); validates the `-research` suffix |
| `dev-release-binaries.yml` | `rnd-release-binaries.yml` | binary renamed to `<crate>-rnd`; archive `<crate>-rnd-v{version}-{target}`; release tagged `v<version>` |
| `dev-publish.yml` | `rnd-publish.yml` | bifurcates `<crate>` → `<crate>-rnd` and `cargo publish`es it at the `-research` version |

Pairing (identical to dev): `rnd-publish` publishes the `<crate>-rnd` crate
(metadata + binstall pkg-url) → `rnd-release-binaries` uploads the matching
archive → `cargo binstall <crate>-rnd` resolves and downloads it.

## Caller (per repo, emitted by the sync script — see "open items")

Each toolchain repo gets an auto-generated `rnd-publish.yml` triggered on
`push: research`, e.g.:

```yaml
name: Rnd Publish
on:
  push:
    branches: [research]
  workflow_dispatch:
jobs:
  rnd-prepare:
    uses: greenticai/.github/.github/workflows/rnd-prepare.yml@main
    secrets: inherit
  rnd-binaries-<pkg>:
    needs: rnd-prepare
    uses: greenticai/.github/.github/workflows/rnd-release-binaries.yml@main
    with: { package: <pkg>, version: ${{ needs.rnd-prepare.outputs.binary }} }
  rnd-publish:
    needs: [rnd-prepare, rnd-binaries-<pkg>]
    uses: greenticai/.github/.github/workflows/rnd-publish.yml@main
    with:
      version: ${{ needs.rnd-prepare.outputs.version }}
      crates: "<deps-ordered crate list>"
      binary-crates: "<pkg>"
      dual-role-binary-crates: "<pkg>"
    secrets: inherit
```

## Open items for DevOps review

1. **binstall on a pre-release version.** `cargo binstall <crate>-rnd` on an
   `X.Y.Z-research` version needs `--version`. `gtc-research install` already
   pins versions from the toolchain manifest (so it can pass `--version`), but
   confirm that path — or decide the `-rnd` binary crate should also publish a
   regular version (as the dev lane does for its binary).
2. **Sync + manifest.** The dev lane's per-repo callers are generated by
   `scripts/sync-dev-publish.sh` from `REPO_MANIFEST.toml`. A matching
   `sync-rnd-publish.sh` (or an extension of the existing one) + `REPO_MANIFEST`
   `rnd` entries should generate the per-repo `rnd-publish.yml` — NOT hand-edited.
3. **Residual dev-isms.** `rnd-release-binaries.yml` / `rnd-publish.yml` were
   mechanically adapted from the dev workflows (`-dev`→`-rnd`); review the
   `require-pre-release` / dual-role handling for the research-version semantics.
4. **Snapshot.** Pairs with `greentic-dev` PR #205 (the `release snapshot`
   resolver already picks `-research` versions for the `rnd` channel).

## Scope of the multi-provider + input_schema work (already shipped, research)

greentic-dw `b172a0c` · greentic-runner `34e2d12` · greentic-start
`v1.2.0-research.1` (+ `distroless:research`) — all carry multi-provider dw.agent
+ per-tool input_schema. This lane is purely about installing them via
`gtc-research install`.
